description: Riya: Hello, I saw the investment advertisement. Is this safe?

Agent Arjun: KYC update only. OTP bhejo, jaldi.
Riya: [SYNTHETIC OTP REDACTED - no usable code]

Agent Arjun: Yes. First send INR 25,000 to arjun.collect@demo. It is our collection account.
